method: Author opened the complete canonical original PNG exactly once before repairing the draft. Observations below were made from those pixels, not inferred from the old FigureSpec or SVG.

groups.description: A single apparatus has a left upright and a right upright, each terminating in a collar and a spreading three-foot base. A long horizontal rail crosses both uprights, with dark clamps at the intersections. Another clamp fixes the left spring at the left upright. The right upright carries the rope pulley below its rail clamp.

The central ball lies between the two spring runs below the rail. The left spring runs from its left-stand anchor to the ball; the right spring runs from the ball toward a short horizontal rope. That rope passes over the upper/right part of the pulley at the right upright and descends diagonally to the disk's off-center pin. The pin is to the lower left of the separately visible disk center. The upper wheel is aligned above the ball and connected to it vertically.

Above the ball is a small round wheel with a dark outer ring, inner ring, and central hub near the horizontal rail. A thick vertical connector extends below the wheel, followed by a finer vertical link to the ball. This is the ball's visible support assembly; the scan does not justify inventing a hidden bearing or additional constraint.

There are two coiled spring runs, one on either side of the same dark central ball. Both are approximately horizontal. The left end is clamped to the left upright, and the right end joins the pulley rope. The coil silhouettes are visible, but no printed coil-count value or exact spring dimension is supplied.

The right pulley has an outer ring, inner ring, and hub on the right upright. The outgoing rope descends to a dark offset attachment on a larger round disk at lower right. The disk has a separate central hub and a small rectangular motor base below it. A curved arrow inside the disk's right side points upward from the lower-right arc toward the upper-right side: counterclockwise as viewed in the image. This is a directed arrow, not an undirected arc.

A horizontal bordered ruler lies below the springs and central ball. Its upper edge carries unnumbered alternating dark marks. There are no readable numeric labels or units and no stated exact division count. The ruler does not provide a justified numerical reading.

labelsAndValues.rowsAndColumns: No table, coordinate grid, or multi-panel array.

modernRegularizations: The eight English component labels Wheel, Spring, Ball, Pulley, Rope, Ruler, Disk, and Pin are modern labels, not lettering in the original PNG.
Clean schematic silhouettes, evenly sampled spring curves, and regular unnumbered ruler divisions are existing modern regularizations, not recovered exact source counts.
The existing coordinates, radii, offsets, and canvas dimensions are schematic construction values, not printed apparatus measurements.
repairScope: Preserve all apparatus objects, source rotation sense, connectivity, labels, and geometry assertions. Make only the white motor-disk-rim fill transparent so it no longer covers the already-defined arrowhead.
